WITH guard AS (
                   SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_sequence), 0) + 1 AS expected_min
                   FROM persistent_outbox_archive_chunks
               ),
               inserted AS (
                   INSERT INTO persistent_outbox_archive_chunks (path, min_sequence, max_sequence)
                   SELECT $1, $2, $3
                   WHERE (SELECT expected_min FROM guard) = $2
                   ON CONFLICT (path) DO NOTHING
                   RETURNING path
               )
               -- "recorded" = inserted by this statement OR already
               -- present (the idempotent rerun). `false` means the
               -- contiguity guard rejected an overlapping chunk.
               SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
                   OR EXISTS(
                       SELECT 1 FROM persistent_outbox_archive_chunks
                       WHERE path = $1 AND min_sequence = $2 AND max_sequence = $3
                   ) AS "recorded!"
